bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 11 AM PDT THIS MORNING... Combined seas building to 8 to 11 ft through Friday morning, subsiding to 6 ft later Friday. Bar conditions rough, becoming moderate. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 300 AM this morning, 330 PM this afternoon and 345 AM Saturday morning.
